niche_preference_profile: This user consistently prefers interfaces that feel complete, structured, and immediately usable. They favor strong information hierarchy, visible content up front, clear grouping into sections or cards, and obvious actions/navigation. They often like polished, premium-looking layouts with cohesive styling, balanced spacing, and strong scanability. They repeatedly choose screens that show real options, details, prices, statuses, or list items immediately rather than sparse or empty states that require typing first. They also prefer layouts where the main task is clearly prioritized and not visually fragmented by competing elements.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers clear top-to-bottom hierarchy with distinct sectioning, strong grouping of title/content/actions, and layouts that make scanning effortless.
Prefers populated screens that show options, products, countries, requests, or details immediately, rather than sparse, empty, or search-only layouts.
Prefers content organized into well-separated cards, modules, rows, or sections with consistent grouping rather than fragmented or undifferentiated layouts.
Prefers interfaces with obvious next actions, prominent CTAs, visible navigation, and controls that make interaction paths easy to discover.
Prefers refined, modern, productized interfaces with cohesive component styling and a more premium, intentional presentation over generic or unfinished-looking screens.
Prefers layouts where the primary task or core content clearly dominates, with fewer competing decorative or secondary elements distracting attention.
Prefers explicit labels, descriptive action text, visible field labels, counts, and status cues that reduce ambiguity and improve comprehension.
